name.en-US: A Dialogue of Comfort against Tribulation
name.pt-BR: Diálogo de Consolo contra a Tribulação

description.en-US: More's last great book, written in the Tower of London in 1534: a dialogue between the Hungarian Vincent and his uncle Anthony on how to bear tribulation under the threat of the Turk, in three books on the comfort in tribulation, the ills of prosperity and the sure refuge in Christ's Passion.
description.pt-BR: O último grande livro de More, escrito na Torre de Londres em 1534: um diálogo entre o húngaro Vicente e seu tio Antônio sobre como suportar a tribulação diante da ameaça turca, em três livros.

sources.edition: A dialoge of comfort against tribulacion (London: Tottel, 1553), EEBO-TCP A07696.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 1348 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. Thomas More died in 1535; the edition is of 1553 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
